cluster_stories.title: UN talks pledge to draft ‘killer robot’ rules by 2028 after Russian pushback
cluster_stories.summary: UN talks on regulating weapons with little or no human oversight ended on Saturday with a pledge ‌for further discussions to develop new rules within two years, an outcome weakened by Russia’s opposition and disappointing human rights groups. Proponents had called for legally binding rules within a short time frame to regulate weapons systems that can identify and engage targets with varying degrees of autonomy, sometimes called “killer robots”. Around 100 countries backed this position but big...
cluster_stories.headline: UN Pledges Autonomous Weapons Rules by 2028 Despite Russian Opposition

cluster_stories.title: Countries open path towards ‘killer robots’ pact
cluster_stories.summary: After five days of talks at the United Nations, which dragged on into overtime, states agreed on building some form of pact over the next two years.
cluster_stories.headline: Nations Agree to Draft Autonomous Weapons Pact by 2028

cluster_stories.title: Wall Street Confronts AI Reality Check
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg US equities reporter Natalia Kniazhevich tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Anthropic’s record IPO failed to reverse deteriorating market sentiment as investors grapple with Nvidia turmoil, AI spending concerns and selling by systematic funds. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kniazhevich explains why Goldman Sachs’ Panic Index has reached 9 out of 10 and what heavy positioning, weak liquidity and a wave of potential new stock issuance could mean for markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: Anthropic IPO Fails to Stop AI Market Selloff
